description: Navigation & Layout improvements + Overview launchpad polish + Getting Started wizard styling + Integration panels (HubSpot, Salesforce) brand headers. These are batched because they all touch Home.tsx and companion CSS in index.css / crm-studio.css, and share the same shadow/hover token patterns established in FEAT-001. FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 must be complete before this FEAT. This FEAT does NOT change component props or routing.
steps: Step 1 — Sidebar sticky header with backdrop blur. In index.css, update .workspace-sidebar to add: position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; overflow-y:auto; backdrop-filter:blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);. This gives the sidebar a frosted-glass feel as content scrolls. Also enhance .nav-item.active: add a left accent bar using box-shadow instead of the current inset shorthand to make the border thicker and more visible: box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--purple-600), inset 0 0 0 1px transparent; add transition: all .18s ease-out. Update .nav-item:hover to add box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs).

Step 2 — Workspace launchpad cards in Home.tsx: the three launchpad buttons already exist but lack visual hierarchy. In index.css, update .workspace-launchpad button: add box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); transition:transform .18s ease-out, box-shadow .18s ease-out, border-color .18s ease-out;. Update .workspace-launchpad button:hover: add box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); transform:translateY(-2px);. Add an animation so buttons stagger in on first render: .workspace-launchpad button:nth-child(1) { animation:fadeInUp .35s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) .05s both; } .workspace-launchpad button:nth-child(2) { animation:fadeInUp .35s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) .12s both; } .workspace-launchpad button:nth-child(3) { animation:fadeInUp .35s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) .19s both; }. Also update the em element inside: .workspace-launchpad button em already defined in FEAT-001.

Step 3 — Header polish in index.css: add animation to the workspace header on first paint: .workspace-header { animation:fadeInUp .3s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) both; }. Enhance .command-hint: add border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 10px; transition:background .15s ease-out; and :hover { background:var(--purple-50); }.

Step 5 — HubSpotPanel.tsx: add a brand-colored header to the Card. After <CardTitle>HubSpot records</CardTitle>, add a connection status badge below the title row. In the CardHeader, wrap CardTitle in a div with a HubSpot-orange accent: add className='hubspot-header' to the CardHeader div. In index.css add: .hubspot-header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; } .hubspot-brand-dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:#ff7a59; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,122,89,.15); }. In the JSX, before CardTitle, add <span className='hubspot-brand-dot' aria-hidden='true' />. For the sync job status items in the details section, add className='sync-job-row' to the per-job div. In index.css: .sync-job-row { padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); } .sync-job-row:last-child { border-bottom:0; }. Also update the preview table inside HubSpotPanel: change the max-h-72 overflow-auto border rounded div to also include className='hubspot-preview-table'. In index.css: .hubspot-preview-table { border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; } .hubspot-preview-table th { background:var(--muted); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }

Step 6 — SalesforceWorkspace.tsx: add brand styling to the main card and connection state UI. Add className='salesforce-header' to the CardHeader. In index.css: .salesforce-header { border-bottom:3px solid #00a1e0; padding-bottom:16px; } .salesforce-brand-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:5px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:#e6f4fb; color:#0070a8; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; } .salesforce-connected { background:#e3f4ec; color:#1a7a44; }. In the JSX, add a status pill next to the organisation name when connected: wrap the

Connected to {status.data.organisation}

text in a {status.data.organisation}. For contact result buttons, add className='sf-contact-btn' and remove the inline className with template literals; define: .sf-contact-btn { display:block; width:100%; text-align:left; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px; background:var(--card); transition:background .15s ease-out, border-color .15s ease-out; } .sf-contact-btn:hover { background:var(--purple-50); border-color:var(--purple-300); } .sf-contact-btn.selected { background:var(--purple-100); border-color:var(--purple-400); }. Replace the existing className={`block w-full text-left rounded border p-3 ${contactId === contact.Id ? 'bg-muted' : ''}`} with className={`sf-contact-btn${contactId === contact.Id ? ' selected' : ''}`}.
